description: Per-room and per-cause death tallies for every player, from one trigger row. Uses ${event.deathZone} rather than ${zone} on purpose: player.death fires AFTER the respawn move, so the dispatcher's ${zone} is the vat, not the grave. The line only lands from the third death in the same room onward, after a beat long enough to clear the respawn narration.

l1.text: You know that ceiling. You have studied it from that exact angle before.

l2.text: Third time in that room, at least. It's starting to feel less like bad luck and more like a subscription.

l3.text: Somewhere a ledger notes the repeat address and doesn't editorialise.

name: Death — the room remembers
